Bug_Details: Optional.ifPresent is preferred over Optional.map when the return value is unused
Bug_Explanation: The `map` method is used on an Optional object, but the returned Optional is not used afterwards. This is a common mistake and can be easily fixed by using `ifPresent` instead.
